headline: Meta edits terms after backlash over AI training on scraped news content
summary: Meta's new commercial terms initially allowed it to crawl and use content from affiliated business sites, including news publishers, to train its AI. After backlash, Meta removed that language, though a spokesperson said the edit does not reflect any change in how Meta actually crawls the web. The revised terms still do not commit to respecting robots.txt.
